why_this_direction: The current component-direction loop reduced full fresh loss, but its other104-merge continuous cross terms turned adverse on three consecutive measured updates, and two consecutive native downstream totals rose. Include those original downstream losses in the first-projection request itself. This tests a diagnosed directional tradeoff without changing the objective, reference, selected weight block or response scale.
repeating_pattern_check: A scalar full-loss step length cannot rotate a request formed only from the first-component loss. Repeated adverse downstream cross terms are distinct from the separately measured native mismatch. Differentiate the full current original objective through all downstream input/output, attention and cache paths in one backward call, then retain the same all-mode map and actual fresh evaluation. No copied historical direction, extra candidate search, arbitrary rate or zero-loss requirement.
hypothesis: Using the complete original computational loss to form the first-projection request will reduce collateral opposition and improve complete fresh-loss progress relative to the mechanism seen in the component-derived direction.
what_went_wrong_before: A scalar full-loss step length cannot rotate a request formed only from the first-component loss. Repeated adverse downstream cross terms are distinct from the separately measured native mismatch. Differentiate the full current original objective through all downstream input/output, attention and cache paths in one backward call, then retain the same all-mode map and actual fresh evaluation. No copied historical direction, extra candidate search, arbitrary rate or zero-loss requirement.
rule: Reacquire current native trace and computational correspondence; one full backward call differentiates the original all105-merge computational loss to A_full at the first attention projection, preserving downstream inputs, outputs and shared caches. Form D=-A_full.T U diag(1/sigma) Vt from fresh H with every mode; other direction blocks zero. Full105-residual JVP gives alpha. For all70 matrices retain wanted=F32(F64(Wnative)+F64(R)+eta*alpha*F64(D)), native BF16 encoding, and Rnext=F32(wanted-Wnext). Install completely, regenerate and measure the complete fresh path.
prediction: The full-request direction will show less adverse downstream response while complete fresh native loss continues falling. Individual merges may still worsen; every105-merge total and both existing predictions remain recorded.
would_weaken_it: Persistently adverse downstream response, worse full fresh-loss progress, or a widening native/prediction discrepancy weakens the proposed correction; a zero first-block direction does not establish global closure.
